newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Keast offshore well has gas - Woodside.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Keast offshore well has gas - Woodside.

text.p: Woodside Petroleum Ltd said on Tuesday that wireline logging of the Keast-1 exploration well offshore Western Australia confirmed the presence of 76 metres of gross gas column in three separate reservoirs.
The well, in permit WA-6L, was at a depth of 3,620 metres and running seven-inch casing in preparation for production testing, Woodside said in a brief drilling report.
WA-6-L is on Australia's North West Shelf.

Equal partners in the North West Shelf project are units of The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd, The British Petroleum Co Plc, Japan Australia LNG (MiMi) Pty Ltd, a partnership of Mitsui & Co Ltd and Mitsubishi Corp, Chevron Corp, Royal Dutch/Shell Group and Woodside.
Woodside shares dropped 27 cents to A$9.45 on Tuesday but they are still much closer to their 12-month high of A$10 than their low of A$6.60.
